name: synology
description: Use a Synology NAS (DSM 7) from Claude: files (File Station), Synology Drive, Synology Photos, Download Station, Container Manager (Docker) and NAS status. Read-only unless you turn writes on.

url.title: NAS URL
url.description: DSM address with port (http://192.168.1.10:5000, https://nas.example.com:5001) or quickconnect:<your QuickConnect ID> to reach it from anywhere

username.title: DSM user
username.description: Preferably a dedicated, non-admin user with access only to the shared folders Claude should see

password.title: DSM password
password.description: Stored in the system credential store

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: When on (default), only reading tools are available. Turn off to let Claude create, move, delete and add downloads

insecure_tls.title: Accept an invalid HTTPS certificate
insecure_tls.description: Only for https URLs with a self-signed or expired certificate, on a network you trust

device_id.title: 2FA device token
device_id.description: Only for accounts with 2-step verification: the SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID printed by `npx synology-mcp register-device`

nas_name.title: Name of this NAS
nas_name.description: Only with a second NAS: a short name to tell them apart (e.g. home). Default: default

nas2_name.title: Second NAS: name
nas2_name.description: Optional second NAS, e.g. office. Claude switches between them with use_nas

nas2_url.title: Second NAS: URL
nas2_url.description: Leave empty for a single NAS. Same format as the NAS URL

nas2_username.title: Second NAS: DSM user
nas2_username.description: Only with a second NAS: the DSM user on it

nas2_password.title: Second NAS: DSM password
nas2_password.description: Only with a second NAS: its password, stored in the system credential store

nas2_device_id.title: Second NAS: 2FA device token
nas2_device_id.description: Only if that account uses 2-step verification: the SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID that `npx synology-mcp register-device` prints when run against the second NAS

nas_file.title: NAS list file (3 or more NAS)
nas_file.description: Optional: path to a JSON file listing several NAS (see the README, Multiple NAS). Overrides the fields above
